nodes.label: Modification Type Entity
nodes.rationale: Referenced in config.yml policy section with LLM-based reconciliation using archaeological specialist role.

nodes.label: Site Entity
nodes.rationale: Materialized entity with geographic coordinates (latitude_dd, longitude_dd) and PostGIS geometry; alternate identity via national_site_identifier.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Policy
nodes.rationale: Defines site-specific proximity boost (0.2-10km) and place name similarity boost (threshold 0.3, max 0.1), plus modification_type lookup policy with archaeological specialist role

nodes.label: SEAD Authority Service Main Configuration
nodes.rationale: Production-safe defaults with environment variable substitution; mounted into the container at runtime.

nodes.label: Docker Configuration Template
nodes.rationale: Sanitized config template mirroring the deployment config layout without environment-specific secrets; uses env-var substitution with defaults.

nodes.label: Docker Entity Table Specifications
nodes.rationale: Identical content to config/entities.yml (same sha256); tracked sanitized copy for Docker deployment.

nodes.label: Location Resource Definition
nodes.rationale: Defines the location resource with fuzzy search via authority.fuzzy_location and details from authority.location table

nodes.label: Site Resource Definition
nodes.rationale: Defines site resource with geospatial queries including distance calculation (ST_Distance in Web Mercator), location similarity, and national ID lookup

nodes.label: FastAPI Application
nodes.rationale: Single FastAPI process on port 8000 with no frontend layer; all interaction via REST API. Stateless across requests except for the connection pool singleton.

nodes.label: OpenRefine
nodes.rationale: External client submitting reconciliation queries via HTTP (POST /reconcile). Inbound integration.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Coordinates batched reconciliation requests: extracts entity type, looks up registered strategy, retrieves candidates, scores them, and formats results in OpenRefine response structure. Batch queries processed sequentially (known limitation).

nodes.label: Reconciliation Router
nodes.rationale: OpenRefine-compatible endpoints (POST /reconcile, GET /suggest/*, GET /flyout/entity, GET /reconcile/preview). Parses form-encoded or JSON query format and delegates to the reconciliation orchestrator. No business logic.

nodes.label: SEAD Authority Service

nodes.label: abundance (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of analysis_entity; also acts as aggregate root for abundance_property.

nodes.label: abundance_ident_level (Bridge)
nodes.rationale: Relationship entity connecting abundance and identification_level; identity derived from foreign keys.

nodes.label: abundance_modification (Bridge)
nodes.rationale: Relationship entity connecting abundance and modification_type; identity derived from foreign keys.

nodes.label: abundance_property
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of abundance; value object with identity inherited from parent context.

nodes.label: Aggregate Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Defines four aggregate roots (abundance, analysis_entity, sample, taxa_tree_master) and their child entities.

nodes.label: analysis_entity (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned root entity with fresh UUID + sequential PK allocation per submission; parent of abundance, geochronology, and relative_dating.

nodes.label: citation (Shared Metadata)
nodes.rationale: Shared metadata entity with reconcile-fuzzy strategy; business key is title + year + authors; the only entity using fuzzy matching.

nodes.label: geochronology
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of analysis_entity in the dating domain.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Strategies
nodes.rationale: Five strategies governing how entities are matched or allocated: allocate, reconcile-exact, reconcile-fuzzy, lookup-only, lookup-extensible, derive.

nodes.label: relative_dating
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of analysis_entity in the dating domain.

nodes.label: sample (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned root entity with business key sample_group_id + sample_name; parent of sample_alt_ref, sample_coordinate, sample_description, sample_dimension.

nodes.label: sample_alt_ref
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of sample in the sample-metadata domain.

nodes.label: sample_coordinate
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of sample in the spatial domain.

nodes.label: sample_description
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of sample in the core/sample-metadata domain.

nodes.label: sample_dimension
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of sample in the sample-metadata/physical-properties domain.

nodes.label: sample_feature (Bridge)
nodes.rationale: Relationship entity connecting sample and feature aggregates; identity derived from foreign keys.

nodes.label: taxa_common_names
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned child of taxa_tree_master in the taxonomy domain.

nodes.label: taxa_tree_master (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: SEAD-Administered classifier with lookup-extensible reconciliation; parent of taxa_common_names.

nodes.label: Data Type Entity
nodes.rationale: Grouped under data_type_group via data_type_group_id foreign key.

nodes.label: Feature Entity
nodes.rationale: Grouped under feature_type via feature_type_id foreign key.

nodes.label: Method Entity
nodes.rationale: Alternate identity via method_abbrev_or_alt_name; uses ivfflat_lists=10 with analyze=true (unusual compared to other entities).

nodes.label: Taxa Synonym Entity
nodes.rationale: Joins to taxa_tree_master via taxon_id.

nodes.label: Taxa (Species) Entity
nodes.rationale: Top of the taxonomic hierarchy; grouped under taxa_tree_genus via genus_id foreign key.

nodes.label: Taxa Order Entity
nodes.rationale: Grouped under record_type via record_type_id foreign key.

nodes.label: MCP Retrieval Configuration
nodes.rationale: Configures hybrid retrieval: k_fuzzy=30 (trigram), k_sem=30 (semantic), k_final=20, min_score=0.6, with 768-dim sentence-transformer embeddings and 24h cache

nodes.label: SIMS Identity Policy Configuration
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 covers provider_owned entities only; shared_metadata and relationship entities listed for completeness with policy handling deferred to Phase 2+. Loaded once at startup by src.identity.policy.IdentityPolicy.

nodes.label: Method Resource Definition
nodes.rationale: Defines the method resource with fuzzy search, details query joining tbl_methods with tbl_method_groups, and alternate identity lookup by abbreviation

nodes.label: Method RAG Hybrid Resource
nodes.rationale: RAG hybrid variant of the method resource with no SQL queries defined, relying on semantic retrieval instead of direct SQL
